children: RNS Number : 6247U  Calculus VCT PLC  14 September 2026

The Board of Calculus VCT plc ("the Company") is pleased to announce that it intends to launch a prospectus offer of new ordinary shares for subscription in the 2026/27 and 2027/28 tax years ("the Offer"). The Offer will seek to raise up to £10 million for the Company. The Offer will have an over-allotment facility, which, if utilised, will seek to raise up to an additional £10 million for the Company (with a total fund-raising of up to £20 million including the over-allotment facility).
Full details of the Offer will be contained in the prospectus which is expected to be published in October 2026.
